sv.title: 75 dagar utan regering – detta har hänt
sv.summary: Det har gått 75 dagar sedan valdagen. Det är fortfarande oklart vilken regering Sverige ska få. Här är turerna i regeringsbildningen.

en.title: 75 days without a government – here's what has happened
en.summary: It has been 75 days since election day. It is still unclear which government Sweden will get. Here are the twists and turns of the government formation.
